title: Recipe Runner
description: Run community presets: video, audio, and image conversions in one click.
guideTitle: How to run a conversion preset
guideContent: Pick a recipe, drop a file, and download the result. Recipes are plain JSON presets maintained by the community — no new code runs, just trusted engines with prebuilt settings.

faqs.question: What is a recipe?
faqs.answer: A JSON preset (FFmpeg args, image format settings) versioned in recipes/. Anyone can propose one via a tool-request issue.

faqs.question: Is it private?
faqs.answer: Yes. Recipes execute locally in your browser with the same engines as the built-in tools.

privacyNotes: Recipes run locally. Nothing is uploaded.
